pages.text: Right click retracts the whip and raises it to block. Taking a hit within 0.5 seconds of raising the guard (or pressing right click within 0.5 seconds of being hit) is a perfect block: the whip snaps out and throws the whole damage back at the attacker while you take none - but the guard then drops and you must release right click before you can raise it again. Any other blocked hit is only reduced by 40%.
